objectives.name: Key Site
objectives.description: Nominate one Dropsite at least 24” from your Deployment Zone before the game. If you Control it at the end of the game, gain 2VP. If this Dropsite is within 6” or inside your opponent’s Deployment Zone, gain 3VP instead.

objectives.name: Priority Target
objectives.description: Nominate one Medium or Large Dropsite at least 24” from your Deployment Zone before the game. If you have Levelled it, at the end of the game gain 2VP. If this Dropsite is within 6” or inside your opponent’s Deployment zone, gain 3VP instead.

objectives.name: Long Shot
objectives.description: Nominate one Feature in a Dropsite within 12” of an opponent’s Deployment Zone before the game. If you have destroyed it, or a deployed enemy Deployable Feature within 12” of their Deployment Zone at the end of the game, gain 2VP. Each Feature can only be nominated once but a Dropsite can have more than one nominated Feature.

objectives.name: Annihilate
objectives.description: You are awarded 1VP at the end of the game for every 500 points of Ships and Admirals you have destroyed. A maximum of 3VP may be scored using this Secondary Objective.

objectives.name: Take Prizes
objectives.description: You are awarded 1VP at the end of the game for every 100 points of Ships you have captured. A maximum of 3VP may be scored using this Secondary Objective.

objectives.name: Gather Intel
objectives.description: You are awarded 1VP whenever you survey a Dropsite at least 24" away from your deployment zone. Any Capital Ship within 6” of the Dropsite and able to fire Weapons may substitute all attacking and launching that round to Survey it. Each Dropsite may be Surveyed once per player per game. A maximum of 2VP may be scored using this Secondary Objective. If the Scenario normally uses Survey, these VP are scored in addition to those in the Scenario.

objectives.name: Decapitate
objectives.description: You are awarded 2VP if an opponent’s highest-level Admiral has been killed for any reason (or one of if there are multiple with the same Level).

objectives.name: Objectives Beyond
objectives.description: Nominate one of your Ships of Tonnage M or higher. You may permanently fly that Ship off the board in any opponent’s Deployment Zone. If you do and that ship is not Crippled, gain 1VP. If that ship was H or C tonnage, gain 2VP instead.

Aegis-X.description:
All Ships with this rule in a Group in coherency combine their X values into a single value Y.
Friendly Groups in coherency within 6” of a Ship with this rule and the same Orbital Layer (including its own Group) gain the benefits of Aegis.
When rolling saves against Close Action and Bomber (of any type) attacks, those Groups gain Y additional save dice they may add to their Energy or Kinetic saves. Before rolling to save, the defending player assigns these dice against specific weapons, divided up as they choose (including any modified hits) between any Energy or Kinetic saves.
An Aegis Group can only grant the benefits of Aegis once each time a friendly group is attacked.
A friendly Group can only benefit from Aegis from one Group each time it is attacked.
Aegis has no effect on Backup saves or saves that replace Energy and Kinetic saves (such as Shield saves).
In addition, Ships benefiting from Aegis increase the number of bombers required to trigger Saturation Fire by Y.
e.g. A Ship benefiting from Aegis-2 would suffer one Core hit per bomber above 8, rather than 6.

Cloak-X.description: This Group may have a maximum of X Spikes.

Command Ship-X.description: Increase the Level of any Admiral assigned to this Ship by X.

Descent.description:
Ships with the Descent special rule are designed to work in Atmosphere and are referred to as Descent Ships, which may be part of Descent Groups. The atmospheric operational depth of these Ships is far lower than normal ships.
When attacking a City or a Descent Ship in Atmosphere, that attack always hits on a 6+ and can never cause a critical.
When attacking a non-Descent Ship in Atmosphere, reduce the lock of Weapons attacking it by 1.
When attacking into Orbit from Atmosphere, any attack always hits on a 6+.
A non-Descent Ship that ends its activation in Atmosphere takes D3 damage. Colossal Ships take 2D3 damage instead.

Detector.description:
If this Ship is on an order that allows it to attack, this Ship may forgo one allowed Weapon use during its activation. If it does, at the end of its activation place two Spikes on an enemy Group in line of sight. A Group that uses Detector gains a Spike (regardless of the amount of Ships using this rule).
e.g. A Ship with 1 Weapon and Detector on General Quarters would be able to either attack with its single Weapon or use its Detector rule.

Escort.description: At the start of the game, before deployment, assign this Group to escort a friendly Group of H or C Tonnage. An Escort Group and its escorted Group are a pair, no other Groups can be part of this pair. Until either Group is destroyed, the pair activate and perform their actions (moving, turning, attacking, etc) simultaneously and count as a single Group when generating pass tokens. The pair do not need to choose the same Order when they activate. Escort Groups are deployed alongside their escorted Group, ignoring tonnage restrictions for the Escort Group. The pair do not need to be in coherency, however while both Groups are within 6” of each other they ignore Saturation Fire from enemy Bombers

Gateship-X.description:
Shaltari Motherships must launch their Dropships via a Ship/Dropsite with this rule (sometimes referred to as Gateships). Each Gateship can have up to X Dropships deployed from it each round. Note: though the launch is measured from the Gateship, it is the Mothership that is launching.
When this Ship goes on the Max Thrust or Damage Control orders, it reduces its Gateship-X value to 0 until the start of its next activation.

Hero.description: You can only include two Groups with this special rule in your fleet. You cannot assign an Admiral to this Ship when building your fleet.

Impetuous.description: At the start of each round, friendly Groups with this rule improve the Lock of their Weapon Systems by 1 until you activate a friendly Group without this rule.

Marines-X.description: Remove X enemy Battalions from this Ship at the beginning of the Battalion Combat step.

Monitor.description: Ships with this rule may not use Course Change or Max Thrust orders.

Mothership.description:
Shaltari Motherships can only deploy their Dropships via friendly Ships or controlled Dropsites with the Gateship-X special rule (sometimes referred to as Gateships).
These Gateships must be within 18” of the Mothership or part of a chain of Gateships with each Gateship in the chain being within 18” of another. Note: though the launch is measured from the Gateship, it is the Mothership that is launching.

Payload S/L-X.description:
When building your fleet, you may choose as many Payload Ships as you like— tonnage limits do not apply to these Ships, and they have no Group size. All Payload S/L Ships must be assigned to a Porter S/L Ship with the same letter. Payload Ships may not activate or be targeted until detached.
Payload Ships take up X of a Porter Ship’s capacity.
During the Porter Ship’s activation, if it is on an Order that allows it to Launch, you may detach one or more of its Payload Ships and place them within 3” of it. In the round they are detached, these Payloads activate together immediately as part of the Porter Ship’s activation after it has completed its Order. In subsequent rounds, all your Payload Ships count as being part of a single Group. Crippling Effects, Spikes, and other rules that affect an entire Group only affect the targeted Payload Ship.
Payload Ships always follow General Quarters Orders, even if its Porter is on different Orders. Payload Ships ignore Coherency rules (and do not gain Formation Benefits), have no Lead Ship, are targeted by attacks individually, and these attacks can only damage the targeted Payload Ship.
If a Payload Ship is attached to a Porter Ship when that Ship is destroyed, the Payload Ship is destroyed.

Porter S/L-X.description:
This Ship may be assigned Payload Ships with the same letter up to a total capacity of X.
During a Porter’s activation, it may attach any detached Payload Ships within 3” if it has available capacity. Payload Ships reattached to a Porter Ship are removed from the table to be deployed in a later round.
Any tokens, Spikes, or effects affecting the reattached Payload Ship are removed from that Ship.

Rapid Drop.description: This Ship may launch its Assets at any point during its movement

Rare.description: You may only take one Group of this Ship in a Skirmish-sized game, two in a Clash, three in a Battle, and four in a Reconquest.

Regenerate-X.description: This Ship recovers X lost Hull Points at the end of its activation.

Reinforced Armour.description: Weapons rolling to hit this Ship or its Group can only score criticals against it on a result of a 3 higher than its Lock value.

Shield-X.description:
This Group/Dropsite has an unmodifiable Shield save of X+.
At the start of this Group’s or controlled Dropsite’s activation, you may choose to raise its shields. If you do, this group gains a shields token until the start of its next activation.
While a Group/Dropsite has a shields token, it replaces its Energy and Kinetic saves with its Shield save and triples its Signature value (before Spikes). Shield saves are used against all hits from weapons before making Backup saves. Shield saves must be used before making Backup saves against Core hits. After being attacked, a Group with a shields token gains a Spike.
A Group on Silent Running loses any shields tokens it has and cannot have shields tokens.
Groups that Directly Deploy may start the game with a shields token.
Core Hits caused by Boarding Actions and Saturation Fire cannot be saved by Shield Saves.

Stealth.description: This Ship may fire one Weapon while Silent Running.

Unique.description: You may only take one Group of this Ship.

Vanguard-X.description: Groups with this rule may begin the game Directly Deployed, ignoring the normal Scenario Deployment and Approach Types (though still counting towards Groups Directly Deployed). If it does, it may be deployed up to X” away from your Deployment Zone.

Vectored.description: This Ship may make an additional turn, up to 45 degrees, at any point during its movement, regardless of the Order its Group has taken.

Air to Air.description: This weapon ignores the penalties for attacking Ships in Atmosphere while the attacker is also in Atmosphere.

Alt-X.description:
Only one Weapon or Load with the same Alt value on the same Ship may be used by that Ship each round.
All Alt Weapons with the same value count as the same Weapon when determining how many Weapons a Ship has.

Alt Launch.description: In a round this Weapon is fired this Ship may not launch Assets.

Anti Wing.description:
This weapon may target enemy Wings as if they were Ships (with a Sig of 0”) but reduces its Lock value by 1 for that attack. If it does, for each hit, remove 1 Fighter or 1 Bomber from that Wing or any other enemy Wing within 3” of the target.
When this weapon is assigned to a Torpedo, it reduces its Lock value by 1 instead of always hitting on a 6+.

Arrest-X.description: A Ship damaged by this Weapon reduces its Thrust by X during its next activation. A Ship affected by this rule multiple times before it activates uses the highest X value it is affected by to determine its Thrust reduction.

Bloom-X.description: When you attack with this Weapon System (including separate attacks generated by the Volley-X special rule), the attacking Group gains X Spikes.

Bombardment.description:
This Weapon ignores the penalties for attacking Cities and Ships in Atmosphere.
Improve the Lock of this Weapon by 2 when attacking Cities.
When attacking a Ship in Orbit with this weapon, it always hits on a 6+ and can never cause a critical.
This weapon cannot be used to attack Ships in Orbit while the attacking Ship is in Atmosphere.

Burnthrough-X.description: Each of this Weapon’s critical hits reduces the target’s Energy/Kinetic Save by X for hits caused by this Weapon for this attack. Saves made for other Weapons are unaffected. Roll attacks separately for each Burnthrough Weapon.

Calibre-X.description: Improve the Lock value of this Weapon by 1 when attacking Groups of any of the listed X Tonnage values.

Close Action.description: This weapon does not benefit from Formation Benefits and can only be assigned to targets within Scan range and on the same Orbital Layer as the attacker.

Close Protection.description: After rolling Kinetic or Energy saves against Close Action and Bomber (of any type) attacks, you may declare the use of any number of Fighters. Each Fighter used confers its re-rolls to a defending friendly Group within its Thrust range. The defending player assigns all re-rolls from each Fighter against specific weapons, dividing up Fighters as they choose. Shield and Backup saves cannot be re-rolled this way. Once a Fighter has been used in this way, remove it.

Corruptor-X.description: When this Weapon successfully inflicts damage, place X Battalions on the target.

Crippling-X.description:
If an attack from this Weapon scores at least one Critical hit and then damages a Ship (following normal damage allocation rules), the damaged Ship gains the stated X Crippling Effect regardless of Tonnage. If no effect is listed, roll 2D6 and apply the corresponding Crippling Effect (from the Crippling Effect table).
Crippling Effects caused by Crippling Weapons are in addition to those caused by 7.3.6 Roll for Crippling Effects.
Except for Fire, a Ship can only have one of each type of Crippling Effect token at a time (Spikes are not a Crippling Effect), even when placed from different sources or at different times. Any duplicate effects are ignored and discarded.

Crippling-Fire.description: If an attack from this Weapon scores at least one Critical hit and then damages a Ship (following normal damage allocation rules), the damaged Ship gains this Crippling Effect regardless of Tonnage (in addition to any Crippling Effect from being reduced below half Hull). Fire: Gain a Fire Token. At the start of the End Phase, before the Repair step, this Ship suffers a point of damage for each Fire Token it has. Repairable.

Crippling-2xFire.description: If an attack from this Weapon scores at least one Critical hit and then damages a Ship (following normal damage allocation rules), the damaged Ship gains this Crippling Effect regardless of Tonnage (in addition to any Crippling Effect from being reduced below half Hull). Gain two Fire Tokens (Fire is the one Crippling Effect a Ship may hold more than one of). At the start of the End Phase, before the Repair step, this Ship suffers a point of damage for each Fire Token it has. Repairable.

Crippling-Navigation Offline.description: If an attack from this Weapon scores at least one Critical hit and then damages a Ship (following normal damage allocation rules), the damaged Ship gains this Crippling Effect regardless of Tonnage (in addition to any Crippling Effect from being reduced below half Hull). Navigation Offline: Gain a Navigation Offline token, reducing this Ship’s total movement to 2” (regardless of Thrust) and preventing it from turning or changing Orbital Layer. Repairable.

Crippling-Weapons Offline.description: If an attack from this Weapon scores at least one Critical hit and then damages a Ship (following normal damage allocation rules), the damaged Ship gains this Crippling Effect regardless of Tonnage (in addition to any Crippling Effect from being reduced below half Hull). Weapons Offline: Gain a Weapons Offline token, preventing this Ship from using Weapons or launching Assets. Repairable.

Critical-X.description:
Each of this Weapon’s criticals increases the damage of that hit by X.
E.g. A Critical-2 weapon rolls 2 dice to attack, one is a hit and the other is a critical. The hit deals its normal damage while the critical increases the damage it causes by 2.

Escape Velocity.description:
This weapon ignores the penalty for attacking Ships in Orbit and treats all Ships in Atmosphere as non-Descent Ships, so only reduces its Lock by 1 when attacking Ships in Atmosphere.
Close Action weapons with this special rule may be used against targets in Orbit while the attacking Ship is in Atmosphere.

Flash-X.description: When this Weapon inflicts damage, the damaged Group (or Ship if it ignores the usual coherency rules) gains X Spikes.

Focused.description:
Instead of the normal potential targets for Weapons, this Weapon’s potential targets are either:
• A single enemy Ship.
• A Dropsite containing no friendly Battalions.
Damage caused by this Weapon is allocated to only the target.

Fusillade-X.description: This Weapon increases its Attack value by X while its Ship is on Weapons Free.

High Power.description:
Unless the attacking Ship is on the Weapons Free Order, attacking with this Weapon counts as attacking with two Weapons (though it only fires once).
Ships with only a single High Power Weapon can only attack with it while on the Weapons Free Order.

Impel-X.description:
If an attacking Group scores at least X critical hits with this Weapon System against a Group, choose one of the following for each affected Group:
A) Turn all Ships in that Group 45 degrees in the same direction. If the Group scored at least twice X, turn all Ships in that Group 90 degrees in the same direction instead.
B) Move all Ships in that Group up to twice X inches directly forward (measuring from the affected Ships). Ships moved this way cannot be moved into Large Objects or off of the table.
A Group can only be affected by each effect once per Weapon System per attack sequence.

Limited-X.description:
This Weapon can only be fired X times per game.
You may launch a total of X of this Asset per game.
E.g. an asset with Launch 2 & Limited-4 can launch as 2 sets of 2 assets, or up to 4 launches of a single asset.

Linked-X.description: Weapons with the same Linked-X value on the same Ship count as 1 Weapon for Orders purposes. When you attack with a Linked-X Weapon, you attack with all other Weapons on that Ship with the same Linked-X value.

Low Power.description: If a Ship’s Orders allow it to fire Close Action Weapons, it may attack with one Low Power Weapon in addition to any other Weapons allowed by its Order.

Mauler.description:
The Lock value of this weapon is equal to the target’s save value against this weapon’s Type.
E.g., A Kinetic Mauler Weapon attacking a target with 3+ Kinetic Save would have a lock value of 3+.

Overcharge.description: Before assigning Weapons to targets, you may double the Damage value of this Weapon. If you do, this becomes a High Power Weapon for this activation and each attack roll of 6 causes that attacking Ship to lose this Weapon’s unmodified Damage value in hull points. Only one Weapon per Ship may benefit from this rule per activation.

Penetrator.description: Each of this Weapon’s critical hits cause a Core hit instead of its normal Damage Type.

Re-Entry.description:
This weapon ignores the penalties for attacking Ships in Atmosphere while the attacking Ship is in Orbit.
Close Action weapons with this special rule may be used against targets in Atmosphere while the attacking Ship is in Orbit.

Reave-X.description:
Each of this Weapon’s criticals reduces the Energy/Kinetic save used against that hit by X.
E.g. a Reave-1 weapon rolls 3 dice to attack, one is a hit and the other two are a critical. The hit is saved against using the target’s normal save value, the criticals are saved against using the target’s save value reduced by X.

Scald-X.description: If this weapon attacks a target within Scan range of the attacking Ship, reduce the target’s Energy / Kinetic save against this weapon’s hits by X (other attacks and weapons are unaffected).

Status.description:
When you hit with this Weapon, pick one of the following tokens; Defence Systems Offline, Scanners Offline, or Navigation Offline.
At the end of the Inflict Damage step, for each unsaved hit from this weapon, choose one of the defending Ships to gain the selected token, regardless of the amount of damage caused by those hits.
This token is automatically removed at the end of the affected ship’s next activation or the start of the next End Phase, before making repairs (whichever is first).
Tokens gained from this rule are counted separately from normal Crippling Effects. A Ship may only have one of each type of these tokens gained due to this rule.

Sustained Fire.description: If this Weapon attacks a target Group it hit in the previous round, double its Attack value for this attack.

Volley-X.description:
This Weapon counts as 1 Weapon System for Orders purposes. When you assign this Weapon to a target, you assign it to targets up to X times (either the same or different). Once assigned, treat each allocation as a separate weapon for the subsequent steps in the attack sequence.
Broadside Weapons using Volley must alternate arcs when determining and assigning targets (so cannot target the same Group on the same side twice in a row).

Crippling.description: If an attack from this Weapon scores at least one Critical hit and then damages a Ship (following normal damage allocation rules), the damaged Ship suffers a Crippling Effect regardless of Tonnage: roll 2D6 and apply the result from the Crippling Effect table.

Boardable.description:
This Ship can have Battalions Assigned to it as if it were a Space Station.
At the start of the round, this Ship is controlled by a Player if only they have any Battalions on it, lasting until the end of the round.
Players that control a Boardable Ship may activate it as if it were a Ship in their Fleet, after all other Groups have activated.

Civilian Transport.description:
This Ship can only choose the General Quarters order.
This Ship cannot be attacked unless it is controlled by a player. Players cannot attack a friendly Civilian Transport.
This Ship cannot be the target of Abilities.

Mercenary (X).description: This Ship may be used in X faction Fleets. When taken as part of your fleet, this Ship loses its Boardable and Civilian Transport rules.

Point Blank.description: A weapon with this rule can only be assigned targets in base contact and on the same Orbital Layer. This Weapon counts as a Close Action weapon for Orders purposes. This Weapon cannot target Cities.

mercenaries.name: Pungari Thresher Hive Ship
mercenaries.note: Gains Shield-5+ when used in Shaltari fleet

mercenaries.name: Hyperyacht Aurorum
mercenaries.note: Unique. Fighters & Bombers use parent fleet stats.

mercenaries.name: Palatine Command Barge
mercenaries.note: Magellan Lifeboats can transfer Admiral to another H/C ship.

stationArmaments.note: Universal armaments/upgrades for the generic Small/Medium/Large Fleet Space Stations. Verbatim from Fleet_Space_Stations_250818.pdf.

options.name: Deep Space Tracking
options.effect: When this Space Station targets enemy ships, Spikes on those ships have double their normal effect. So a Spike would increase the target's Signature by 6" instead of 3".

options.name: Scanner Uplink
options.effect: This Space Station's Scan range is increased by 3". In addition, friendly ships within 3" of one or more Space Stations with this special rule increase their Scan range by 3". This special rule ceases to function while this Space Station is controlled by an enemy player.

options.name: Astrobotanical Lab
options.subtitle: Exo-Greenhouse
options.effect: Signature Bloom: Friendly Ships within this Space Station's unmodified Signature are Hidden within its Bloom. Enemy Ships targeting a Hidden Ship's Group ignore a Spike for each Hidden Ship in that Group. This rule has no effect while this Space Station is controlled by an enemy player.
